difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a classical Weil cohomology theory the degree of a zero cycle agrees with the cohomological degree of its cycle class (statement lines 1694-1705). The proof (proof lines 1706-1716) reduces to closed points, expresses their classes by compatibility with pushforwards, and computes the degree as one. H2: a short proof with a checkable substitution.
